claim: Duke's DEFS.CON names tiles only in its first section; after the 'Defines weapon' comment come weapon ids, actor motion values, player actions and sound ids whose numbers collide with tiles (read whole, tile 4 is ACTIVATORLOCKED and RPG_WEAPON and more). EDuke32's dnames.h has the same pollution. Duke's letter sprites are three fonts: 2822-2915 ASCII from '!', 2940-2965 capitals from A (not '!' as documented) and 2966-2991 a second undocumented capital style.
evidence: tools/extract_duke_semantics.py split at that comment and cross-checked against the shipped ART: 740 tile names (582 with art), 450 non-tile constants; fonts decoded by tools/read_duke_signs.py (2026-08-28). Duke's mechanisms are named by the ST_*/SE_* enums in reference/eduke32/source/duke3d/src/game.h.
use: Split DEFS.CON before reading tile names from it.

checked.how: tools/extract_duke_semantics.py:39-45 splits at 'Defines weapon'; knowledge/duke3d/semantics-v1.json: tile_count 740, tiles_with_art 582, non_tile_constants 450 (KNEE_WEAPON, RPG_WEAPON...). dnames.h:47 EJECT_CLIP__ = 4 and :190 ACTIVATORLOCKED__ = 4 in one file. tools/read_duke_signs.py:43-45: 2822..2915 ASCII from '!', 2940..2965 capitals from A, 2966..2991 a second capital style.
